title: Verify European calendar language through startup and file load
changes: Follow a normal French selection at the original startup selector through File No. 2 load, using the same machine and the existing authenticated e337-d336 dataset.
validation: Wine thd38sqm reaches the French month 3 offset and its literal at frame 2224, using the original Thumb interpreter with all 100 E537 backing bytes altered. limitations: The replay begins at the startup selector checkpoint at frame 900. Other live languages and months, the 08033448 dispatch context, direct translated reads, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
